summary: Decode engine profiles on tpu7x 2x2x2 (TP=8, PCP=2, DCP=16, MTP=3 -> 4 tokens/req): at concurrency 12 (48 decode tokens, 64-token bucket) sparse MLA indexer takes 19.3% of the decode step; at concurrency 20 (80 decode tokens, 128-token bucket) MoE TP decode crosses the 64-row kernel limit and falls back to gmm_v2 at 28.0% of the decode step.
